![Status: Dalamud testing channel](https://img.shields.io/badge/status-Dalamud%20testing-C9A24B) ![Dalamud API 15](https://img.shields.io/badge/Dalamud-API%2015-4C8BF5) ![License: AGPL-3.0](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-AGPL--3.0-lightgrey) ![Downloads](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/t3sco/Gratis/total?color=4C8BF5) [Install](#install) · [Features](#features) · [Commands](#commands) · [Feedback and bugs](#feedback-and-bugs) · [Credits](#credits)


Gratis keeps the game's maps and replaces the interface around them: a flat glass look in warm gold and crystal blue, fast search, and an optional Quest Log. ## Install Gratis is in the official Dalamud plugin repository's **testing** channel, so you need to opt in to testing builds once. 1. In game, open `/xlsettings`, then Experimental, and tick **Get plugin testing builds**. Save. 2. Open `/xlplugins`, search for Gratis and install it. 3. If you run another map replacement plugin, disable it so the two do not fight over the map. Updates arrive through the normal plugin installer. Testing builds can have bugs, so please report anything odd (see [Feedback and bugs](#feedback-and-bugs)). **Installed Gratis from the old custom repository?** Remove this URL from `/xlsettings`, Experimental, Custom Plugin Repositories, so you do not get two copies of the plugin: ``` https://raw.githubusercontent.com/t3sco/Gratis/master/repo.json ``` Open the map with `/gratis map` or your usual map key. The Quest Log button is at the top right of the map. ## Features - **Search:** find any zone, aetheryte, quest, marker or NPC. Results show the distance, whether you are attuned and what the teleport costs. - **Browse:** leave the box empty to browse by expansion, and use the keyboard throughout. - **Glass interface:** the map fades away when you are not using it, with smooth animation you can turn down or off. - **Remembers your view:** each zone keeps its own view, and small areas and raid arenas fit automatically. - **Markers:** quests, FATEs, flags, aetherytes and your party are always shown. Six lenses and a filter drawer clear a busy zone. - **Quest Log:** browse Accepted, Completed and Available quests beside the map, with details and rewards. It can replace the game's Journal. - **Travel:** see whether an aetheryte is attuned and what the trip costs. Gratis starts the teleport but never moves your character. - **Settings:** simple toggles, five window presets, colour presets, a circular map, and a Classic look if you prefer the old one. You can abandon an accepted quest from its summary in the Quest Log. It asks you to confirm first, and Main Scenario quests cannot be abandoned. Tracking a quest is still done in the game's own Journal.
## Commands | Command | What it does | | --- | --- | | `/gratis` | Open settings | | `/gratis map` | Open or close the map | | `/gratis report` | Save a report to attach to a bug report (no character names) |
https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/7c1cd5d7-6b8c-4117-a95a-717118950f92 ## Feedback and bugs This is an early build and has rough edges. - **Found a bug?** Run `/gratis report`, then open an issue or message me with the saved file and what you saw. - **Quick message:** use the speech-bubble button in the bottom-left of the map. Nothing is sent until you press Send, and only your message and the Gratis version go. Tick "Include a diagnostic report" to add the same report as `/gratis report` (no character name or chat). You can turn the button off under Settings > Feedback button. ## Credits - [Mappy](https://github.com/harbingerftw/Mappy), by MidoriKami (original author) and harbingerftw (maintainer of the fork this is based on, version 3.2.0.0). The map window, marker handling and plugin structure come from their work. - KamiLib and MappyLib, by MidoriKami and contributors. The parts Gratis needs are copied into its own source with their licence kept. - [Geist](https://github.com/vercel/geist-font) by Vercel (SIL Open Font License), Noto Sans CJK by Adobe and Google (SIL Open Font License, preview harness only), [Lucide](https://lucide.dev) icons by Lucide Contributors (ISC) and [Phosphor](https://phosphoricons.com) icons by Phosphor Icons (MIT). - Dalamud (goatcorp), FFXIVClientStructs and Lumina, which Gratis is built against. [NOTICE.md](NOTICE.md) has the full list, with licences and what is derived from what. FINAL FANTASY XIV is a registered trademark of Square Enix.
